Title: Unable to connect to local mp4 file by ExtractorSampleSource
Description: Hello!

I am updating the ExoPlayer to 1.3.1 and I am experiencing the issue with  the playback of the local MP4 files:
com.google.android.exoplayer.ExoPlaybackException: com.google.android.exoplayer.upstream.HttpDataSource$HttpDataSourceException: Unable to connect to /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.getvictorious.staging.eatyourkimchi/files/DCIM/Video/Video-20150518_142803.mp4

I am passing the uri to the ExtractorSampleSource: 
ExtractorSampleSource sampleSource = new ExtractorSampleSource(uri, dataSource, extractor, 2,
                BUFFER_SIZE);

Please advise what could cause this exception.

Thank you in advance!
Edward

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a problem with ExtractorSampleSource in ExoPlayer 1.3.1 when trying to connect to a local MP4 file. The error message indicates that the HttpDataSource is trying to connect to a local file path as if it were a URL. This is a conceptual issue that can be analyzed without building or running the code. The problem is likely that the user is using HttpDataSource for local files instead of a FileDataSource. The solution would involve using the appropriate data source for local files, which can be verified through code analysis without needing to build the environment. The issue description provides enough information about the error and the code being used to diagnose the problem conceptually.
